3. Part A — R1.3 Composition Engine & Occasion Integrity

A2. Constrained Combinatorial Generator

Replaced template-only look selection with a constrained combinatorial composition generator (CompositionGenerator in src/core/intelligence/composition-generator.ts). Slots are generated dynamically across foundation (top+bottom or one-piece), required climate outerwear (when cool, cold, or rainy), footwear, and balanced accessories.

  • Slot-Level Pruning: Prunes candidate pieces per slot by compatibility before combinatorial Cartesian joining, bounding candidate generation complexity.
  • Hard Filters Enforced: Climate thermal boundaries, fabric weight limits, lining/insulation properties, water resistance, user modesty preferences, style dislikes, and occasion formality constraints.
  • Coherence Constraints: Formality spread ≤ 1 across pieces (except deliberate high-low pairings with shared neutral anchors); structure spread ≤ 2; maximum 3 main non-neutral colors; maximum 1 statement piece in Safe/Best Match tiers.
  • Curated Anchor Bonus: Authored templates retained as curated anchor hints with a calibrated +0.02 bonus, allowing combinatorial looks to compete fairly while preserving signature pairings.
  • Read-Only Candidate API: Full ranked candidate pool exposed via VaelStylingEngine.getRankedCandidateLooks.

VERIFIED BY TEST tests/composition-generator.test.ts (4/4 passed)

A3. Occasion Integrity & Strict Veto Rules

Job Interview formality was recalibrated to formality band [3, 4] (creative interview 3, corporate interview 4). Gala, tuxedo, white-tie, and evening gown items were isolated with dedicated veto rules preventing them from appearing in workplace or interview contexts.

  • Rule 9 (Gala / Wedding Isolation): Formal evening gowns and tuxedo pieces are strictly restricted to wedding-guest (evening), cultural-traditional, and formality-5 dinner.
  • Rule 10 (Interview Integrity): Formality-5 evening pieces and cocktail slip dresses are strictly excluded from job-interview.
  • Profile 17 Calibration: In 32°C hot humid conditions, Profile 17 returns three corporate interview looks featuring poplin shirts, tropical-weight hopsack and cotton-linen tailoring, and dark dress shoes.

VERIFIED BY TEST tests/golden-r12.test.ts (G-04, G-14, Profile 17 tests)

A4 & A6. Grid Coverage & Math Reconciliation

Executed comprehensive 2,880-cell sweep across 4 gender coding directions × 12 occasions × 5 temperatures × 2 conditions × 3 modesty profiles × 2 formality levels.

  • Viability Rate: 2,880 / 2,880 cells (100.0%) return a valid, non-null 3-look proposal.
  • Metric v4 Compliance: All 28 expression × occasion groups pass Metric v4 (mean foundation coding |μ| ≤ 0.25 AND ≥ 1 curated fluid non-footwear piece OR ≥ 2 curated fluid foundation pieces). Professional, Evening, Ceremony, and Cultural groups pass with rates > 90% (24 groups at 100%).
  • Feminine Separates Share: True denominator across 720 feminine cells is 2,160 looks. Separates count is 1,358 (62.9%), One-Piece count is 802 (37.1%), Fix condition (≥ 40%) fully satisfied.
  • Garment Utilization: 156 / 268 catalog garments (58.2%) appear in at least one top-3 look.

4. Part B — R2.0 Studio 3D Styling Avatar Spike

Architecture & Core App Isolation

The 3D Studio feature was engineered as an isolated spike on branch studio. It connects to the recommendation engine purely via read-only adapters without modifying any internal scoring logic or test fixtures.

  • Dynamic Client Chunking: StudioViewer is dynamically imported via next/dynamic with ssr: false. Flagship entry bundles incur 0 KB overhead.
  • Rendering Performance: Headless Chromium / Brave benchmarks confirm 61 FPS desktop average and 61 FPS throttled mobile (4× CPU slowdown). DPR is capped at 1.5, and rendering pauses when the tab or viewport is inactive.
  • 2D Flat-Lay Fallback: Dedicated fallback view renders automatically if WebGL context creation fails, maintaining complete shuffle, lock, and swap functionality.

6. Honest List of What is NOT Done

  • No Real-Time Cloth Physics: Garments use parametric procedural geometry conforming to the mannequin. No fabric collision, tearing, or soft-body simulation is executed client-side.
  • No Custom Anthropometric Sliders: The mannequin uses standardized editorial tailoring proportions. Individual hip, waist, or chest circumference morph targets are omitted in v0.
  • No Photogrammetric Textures: Materials are shaded with procedural PBR roughness, metalness, and tone algorithms derived from catalog attributes.
  • Shuffle Pool Depth: Evaluates ~30–50 valid combinatorial candidates per occasion. Multi-thousand pools are deferred to future wardrobe milestones.
